name: Commodity
description: Physical goods administered or consumed: medicine, vaccine, feed, supplements.

name: Problem
description: Health or operational issues that arise: fever, injury, low ADG, mastitis.

name: Event
description: Scheduled or recurring administrative activity: data collection, filings, updates.

name: Action
description: Direct operational task on animals or groups: birth, death, shifting, reconcile, weaning, tagging.

name: Equipment / Asset
description: Durable assets needing upkeep: water pump, weighing scale, shed structure, feeder, vehicle.
